entities.summary: American track and field athlete (1913-1980) who won four gold medals at the 1936 Berlin Olympics, defying Nazi racial ideology. His victories in the 100m, 200m, long jump, and 4x100m relay before Adolf Hitler and 110,000 spectators became one of the most powerful symbolic moments in sports history.
